artworks.title: Aeneas' Flight from Troy
artworks.description: Barocci's flight from the burning city — the last night of Priam's Troy foreshadowed in the royal line that ran from Dardanus through Laomedon's broken oaths to the sons who would die before the walls.

artworks.title: The Procession of the Trojan Horse into Troy
artworks.description: The end of the house that began with a cow and a Palladium — citizens haul the horse through the gate while the dynasty's last king watches the stratagem close the saga Homer sang.

artworks.title: Aeneas, Anchises, and Ascanius
artworks.description: Bernini's Borghese marble — three generations fleeing Ilion: Anchises with the Penates, Ascanius beside, the Dardanian line leaving Priam's house forever.

artworks.title: The Building of the Trojan Horse
artworks.description: Tiepolo's companion canvas — Epeius' horse rising on the shore, the stratagem that will empty Priam's halls.

artworks.title: Aeneas Fleeing from Troy
artworks.description: Batoni's flight through the burning streets — the last scion of the house of Troy carrying Anchises from the city's fall.
